name: Keel'asa
source:
A mature purple, grey-haired om'veri with dark blue eyes, as well as darker horns and nasal spikes.
Keel'asa is not under the influence of Chime-Kalantre's patriarchal culture. Keel'asa is a wise mentor to the children of the Taidei family and a loyal assistant.
